remarks: WELCOME TO THIS EXCEPTIONAL CONTEMPORARY CHALET SET ON 12+ MOSTLY WOODED ACRES, WHERE PRIVACY, COMFORT AND FOUR-SEASON RECREATION COME TOGETHER! IDEALLY LOCATED JUST 3 MILES FROM DOWNTOWN ELLICOTTVILLE AND ONLY 4 MILES FROM BOTH HOLIDAY VALLEY GOLF/SKI RESORT AND HOLIMONT SKI RESORT, THIS PROPERTY OFFERS THE PERFECT BLEND OF CONVENIENCE AND SECLUSION. OVERLOOKING A PICTURESQUE POND AND SURROUNDED BY NATURE'S SCENERY, THIS IS THE KIND OF PROPERTY THAT FEELS LIKE A TRUE ESCAPE. THE MAIN CHALET FEATURES 3+ BEDROOMS AND 2-1/2 BATHS WITH BEDROOMS ON EACH LEVEL. THE SPACIOUS MAIN LIVING AREA IS ENHANCED BY CATHEDRAL CEILINGS AND A BEAUTIFUL STONE FIREPLACE, CREATING A DRAMATIC YET WELCOMING GATHERING SPACE. THE PRIMARY BEDROOM IS CONVENIENTLY LOCATED ON THIS LEVEL AND OFFERS AN ENSUITE BATH. ALSO ON THE MAIN LEVEL ARE THE LAUNDRY AREA AND A HALF BATH. UPSTAIRS, TWO ADDITIONAL BEDROOMS AND A FULL BATH PROVIDE COMFORTABLE ACCOMMODATIONS FOR FAMILY AND GUESTS. THE WALK-OUT LOWER LEVEL ADDS EVEN MORE LIVING SPACE WITH A GENEROUS FAMILY ROOM, PERFECT FOR GAME NIGHTS, MOVIE WATCHING OR RELAXING AFTER A DAY ON THE SLOPES. STEP OUTSIDE TO THE STAMPED CONCRETE PATIO, COMPLETE WITH PERGOLA, AND ENJOY THE TRANQUIL SURROUNDINGS, POND VIEWS AND ABUNDANT WOODED LAND. A DETACHED 2+ BEDROOM, 1-BATH CABIN PROVIDES ADDITIONAL SPACE FOR GUESTS, FAMILY OR A PRIVATE RETREAT. WITH ITS WOODED ACREAGE, POND, MULTIPLE LIVING SPACES AND SEPARATE CABIN, THIS UNIQUE PROPERTY OFFERS PLENTY OF ROOM TO RELAX, ENTERTAIN AND ENJOY ELLICOTTVILLE'S FESTIVALS AND LIFESTYLE. WHETHER YOU'RE LOOKING FOR A PRIVATE FOUR-SEASON GETAWAY, FAMILY RETREAT OR PLACE TO SHARE WITH FRIENDS, THIS SPECIAL CHALET IS READY TO WELCOME YOU HOME!
